Signal Extension optional
HDBaseT extenders, HDMI distribution amplifiers (splitters), AOC cables, and HDMI audio extractors. Items added here are quoted as additional line items in your BOM.
▾
HDBaseT Extender
Magenta HD-One series. 100m at FHD / 60m at 4K. Configure one set, click "+ Add" to push it to the BOM, then configure another if needed.
HDMI Splitter (Distribution Amplifier)
Magenta MG-DA series. All models 4K60 HDMI 2.0 with HDCP 2.2 and down-scaling. Pick model + qty, click "+ Add" to push to BOM.
AOC Cable (Active Optical)
Magenta MG-AOC series. 4K60 4:4:4 over fiber. Pick signal type, jacket, length, qty.
HDMI Audio Extractor
tvONE / Magenta AP-536. De-embeds audio from an HDMI stream to analog L/R + S/PDIF outputs. Pick qty and click "+ Add" to push to BOM.
Signal Extension items in this BOM
Fill Project Context (top), pick your Requirement, then add any Signal Extension items above — click Generate BoM when ready.
